# Vlad Myahlov — Scientific Software & Instrumentation Engineer

Canonical site: https://myahlovvlad.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/myahlovvlad
ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Vlad_Mahlov

## Professional identity

Vlad Myahlov works at the intersection of measurement science, scientific instrumentation, embedded HMI, scientific software, verification engineering and evidence-oriented automation. The central pattern is to translate physical measurement constraints and operator workflows into explicit software behaviour that can be simulated, tested and verified.

Primary domains:
- scientific instrument control software;
- UV-Vis spectrophotometry and measurement workflows;
- embedded HMI and finite-state-machine modelling;
- hardware abstraction and canonical instrument state;
- verification / validation, FAT/OQ-related testing and metrology;
- laboratory data workflows and controlled handoff;
- firmware research and behavioural reconstruction;
- local-first engineering automation with approval and evidence boundaries.

## Public inspectable projects

### LCD Bitmap IDE
Flagship public engineering proof. Offline workbench for monochrome embedded HMI with LCD authoring, FSM navigation, physical controls, runtime preview, embedded exports and local REST/MCP automation. Public repository: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/LCD-bitmap-IDE

### Q2SC Platform
Research-alpha computational chemistry and predictive-spectroscopy platform with PySCF quantum calculations, QSAR/QSPR, chemometrics and traceability-oriented architecture. Public repository: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/q2sc-platform

### BioCult-KB
Experimental bioprocess modelling and knowledge-system repository connecting cultivation context, process simulation, COBRA/SBML resources, OMICS inputs and documentation. Public repository: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/Cultivation-collagenase

### CardVault
Cross-platform OCR/contact-capture product prototype with human confirmation, local-first storage, QR/vCard exchange and desktop/mobile delivery work. Public repository: https://github.com/myahlovvlad/card-vault-tauri

## Private / employer-associated work

Private engineering work is represented only through sanitized portfolio case studies. The public site does not link private repositories and does not expose private source code, binaries, raw logs, device-specific confidential details, vendor files or unpublished operational data.

The main private case families are scientific instrument control, laboratory data integration, measurement traceability, firmware research and local engineering automation.

## Claim boundaries

Research prototypes are explicitly labelled by maturity and are not represented as production or scientifically validated systems unless public evidence supports that status. Strong claims are controlled through the site claim register.

The older Tilda portfolio is a legacy evidence archive for earlier biotechnology, laboratory, STEM, CAD/3D and educational work rather than a second canonical professional identity. Historical media should be migrated only from original owned/licensed source files.
